name: risk_clues
create_sql:
CREATE TABLE risk_clues (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	clue_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	session_id VARCHAR(256), 
	source_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	project_id VARCHAR(256), 
	room_id VARCHAR(256), 
	stage_snapshot_id VARCHAR(256), 
	phase_id VARCHAR(32), 
	phase_version INTEGER, 
	binding_status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	scene_id VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, 
	rule_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	rule_version VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	conclusion VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	risk_level VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, 
	occurred_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	media_run_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	asset_id VARCHAR(256), 
	start_ms INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	end_ms INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	person_id VARCHAR(256), 
	track_id VARCHAR(256), 
	seat_id VARCHAR(256), 
	gap_id VARCHAR(512), 
	reason TEXT NOT NULL, 
	observation_ids JSONB NOT NULL, 
	missing_facts JSONB NOT NULL, 
	quality_flags JSONB NOT NULL, 
	evidence_refs JSONB NOT NULL, 
	clue JSONB NOT NULL, 
	event_id VARCHAR(36), 
	deduped_from VARCHAR(256), 
	contract_version VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT risk_clue_conclusion CHECK (conclusion IN ('normal','suspected','insufficient')), 
	CONSTRAINT risk_clue_risk_level CHECK (risk_level IN ('none','low','medium','high')), 
	CONSTRAINT risk_clue_level_matches_conclusion CHECK ((conclusion = 'suspected' AND risk_level <> 'none') OR (conclusion <> 'suspected' AND risk_level = 'none')), 
	CONSTRAINT risk_clue_binding CHECK (binding_status IN ('bound','unbound')), 
	CONSTRAINT risk_clue_time_order CHECK (end_ms >= start_ms AND start_ms >= 0), 
	UNIQUE (clue_id)
)

	CONSTRAINT business_fact_phase_text CHECK (length(btrim(phase_id)) > 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES business_projects (project_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(room_id) REFERENCES business_rooms (room_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(person_id) REFERENCES business_persons (person_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,

)

name: phase_snapshots
create_sql:
CREATE TABLE phase_snapshots (
	stage_snapshot_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	session_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	project_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	room_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	source_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	phase_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	phase_version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	effective_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	enabled_scenes JSONB NOT NULL, 
	always_on_scenes JSONB NOT NULL, 
	assets JSONB NOT NULL, 
	rule_versions JSONB NOT NULL, 
	exceptions JSONB NOT NULL, 
	sync_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	actor_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	reason VARCHAR(1024) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (stage_snapshot_id), 
	CONSTRAINT phase_snapshot_binding_scope FOREIGN KEY(session_id, project_id, room_id, source_id) REFERENCES phase_bindings (session_id, project_id, room_id, source_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	CONSTRAINT phase_snapshot_session_version UNIQUE (session_id, phase_version), 
	CONSTRAINT phase_snapshot_session_effective UNIQUE (session_id, effective_at), 
	CONSTRAINT phase_snapshot_version_positive CHECK (phase_version > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT phase_snapshot_sync_status CHECK (sync_status IN ('pending','partially_applied','applied','missing_asset','failed')), 
	CONSTRAINT phase_snapshot_s10_always_on CHECK (always_on_scenes = '["S10"]'::jsonb), 
	CONSTRAINT phase_snapshot_known_phase CHECK (phase_id IN ('SIGNIN','DISCIPLINE','PRELIM','DETAIL','CLARIFY','REPORT')), 
	CONSTRAINT phase_snapshot_actor_text CHECK (length(btrim(actor_id)) > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT phase_snapshot_reason_text CHECK (length(btrim(reason)) > 0)
)

name: phase_control_acks
create_sql:
CREATE TABLE phase_control_acks (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	stage_snapshot_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	session_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	project_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	room_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	source_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	phase_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	phase_version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	consumer_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	received_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	applied_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	error JSONB, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT phase_ack_snapshot_consumer UNIQUE (stage_snapshot_id, consumer_id), 
	CONSTRAINT phase_ack_status CHECK (status IN ('applied','missing_asset','failed')), 
	CONSTRAINT phase_ack_state_consistent CHECK ((status = 'applied' AND applied_at IS NOT NULL AND error IS NULL AND applied_at >= received_at) OR (status <> 'applied' AND applied_at IS NULL AND error IS NOT NULL)), 
	FOREIGN KEY(stage_snapshot_id) REFERENCES phase_snapshots (stage_snapshot_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE phase_control_outbox (
	notification_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	stage_snapshot_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	session_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	project_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	room_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	source_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	phase_version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	required_consumers JSONB NOT NULL, 
	delivery_status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	attempts INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	last_attempt_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	next_attempt_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	published_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	last_error_code VARCHAR(64), 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (notification_id), 
	CONSTRAINT phase_outbox_delivery_status CHECK (delivery_status IN ('pending','published')), 
	CONSTRAINT phase_outbox_attempts_positive CHECK (attempts >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT phase_outbox_required_consumers CHECK (jsonb_typeof(required_consumers) = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length(required_consumers) > 0), 
	UNIQUE (stage_snapshot_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(stage_snapshot_id) REFERENCES phase_snapshots (stage_snapshot_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
